text: SELECT session_id, repo, ref_number, url FROM session_refs WHERE kind='pull_request' AND repo='Sinity/polylogue' AND ref_number=3282
SELECT tool_name, count(*) FROM blocks WHERE session_id='claude-code-session:28407f0f-4f30-4508-b29b-1fd0bc301a39' AND block_type='tool_use' GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY 2 DESC
